podcast.title: Forbes List Recognition
podcast.body: The Rolling Stones were ranked highly on a Forbes list of the most powerful musical brands in the world, attesting to the enduring strength and profitability of their image and brand. "Y en los primeros puestos estaban los Rolling Stones con la lengua."

podcast.title: Iconic Logo
podcast.body: The Rolling Stones are recognized for their famous "tongue" logo, which, alongside the Wu-Tang Clan's 'W', is cited as one of the most powerful musical brand images globally. "estaban los Rolling Stones con la lengua."

podcast.title: Political Leadership Example
podcast.body: The Rolling Stones are used as an example of a band with an absolute political leader in Mick Jagger, who steers the band's strategic and economic direction. "es el absoluto líder político dentro de los Roni Estons."
